entities.summary: Christopher Lyle Cooper is an American former professional football player who was a defensive lineman in the National Football League (NFL) for the Oakland Raiders, Dallas Cowboys, San Francisco 49ers, Seattle Seahawks and Arizona Cardinals. He also was a member of the California Redwoods in the United Football League (UFL). He played college football for the Nebraska–Omaha Mavericks.
